comparison.criterion: For every task, total_tokenized_prompt_length(B_j) equals total_tokenized_prompt_length(C_j).

limitations: This result establishes only a three-token prompt-burden mismatch for every frozen B/C task under the exact pre-open template/tokenizer procedure.
It does not compare semantics, capability, generated work, latency, treatment effects, or White Rabbit claims.
No attempt was made to pad, edit, redesign, or otherwise repair either frozen prelude.
The mismatch blocks the current assay pending separate review or reconstitution; it does not authorize Gate 7 execution.
